summary: hooks/session_end.py unlinks heartbeat_dir()/f'{session_id}.json' with the raw session id, while hooks/post_tool_use.py writes the beat under SAFE_ID.sub('_', session_id)[:64] — no sanitising or truncation on the delete side, so a crafted or >64-char session id could both (a) leave an un-retirable beat under the sanitised name (write/delete name mismatch) and (b) delete a file outside the heartbeat directory
